description:
The codebase has inconsistent file format detection patterns that fail to handle:
1. Compressed files: `data.parquet.zst`, `data.csv.gz`
2. Sharded files: `data.parquet.1`, `data.csv.2`, `data.tbl.1.zst`

Some locations use `is_tpc_format()` which correctly handles compression, but then
check `.parquet` or `.csv` directly on the suffix which breaks for compressed/sharded files.

The existing `is_tpc_format()` utility correctly iterates through suffixes skipping
compression extensions. We need analogous utilities for parquet and csv detection,
then update all locations using direct suffix checks.

This is a follow-up to the TPC delimiter detection consolidation work.

anti_patterns.why: callers depend on the current API

anti_patterns.dont: create a generic format detector class
anti_patterns.why: simple predicate functions match the existing codebase pattern

preserves.behavior: All existing platform tests continue to pass
Existing file format detection behavior for uncompressed files unchanged
is_tpc_format() API and return values unchanged

verifications.description: All fast tests pass after refactoring
